unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must register before entering the center, except overnight staff to whom this registration duty does not apply.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Before entering the center, except for overnight staff.

unit_attributes.statement: Visitors are not required to wear a badge.
Visitors must not carry metal tools inside the center, except maintenance workers performing repairs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Inside the center, except maintenance workers performing repairs.

unit_attributes.statement: This policy does not prohibit visitors from carrying paper maps.
Other building policies may impose additional restrictions.
Overnight staff are exempt from the duty to register before entering the center.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to overnight staff regarding the registration duty in paragraph a.

unit_attributes.statement: The prohibition on carrying metal tools inside the center does not apply to maintenance workers performing repairs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers performing repairs regarding the metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c.

unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers may carry metal tools while performing repairs.
A delay may occur when the visitor desk is busy.
unit_attributes.scope_text: When the visitor desk is busy.

unit_attributes.statement: Staff should record the arrival time of each visitor.
